CMOS 4-bit cyclic barrel shifter
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VD0 d0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 50n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
VD1 d1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 100p 100p 99.9n 200n)
VD2 d2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 200n 100p 100p 199.9n 400n)
VD3 d3 0 PULSE(0 3.3 400n 100p 100p 399.9n 800n)
VS0 s0 0 PULSE(0 3.3 800n 100p 100p 799.9n 1600n)
VS1 s1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 1600n 100p 100p 1599.9n 3200n)
XDUT vdd 0 d0 y0 d1 y1 d2 y2 d3 y3 s0 s1 astra_077_cmos_cyclic_barrel_shifter
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
